title: GENERATED ACTOR FACT -> EMPIRICAL COMPARABILITY AUTHORITY COURT
finite_holdings: D10's empirical-coordinate != generated-nine-stratum-position holding does not prohibit a separate generated-biography -> empirical-conditioner seam.
D08 already supplies the lawful survey-side empirical predicate grammar; D12D specifies authority for deriving the predicate from an actor fact.
No general accepted current actor-fact -> survey-coordinate comparability authority was located.
Current actor-side fact authority is sparse: ADP-010 and ADP-015 own important objective biography/history; ADP-007 v1 does not establish universal demographic initial facts.
Current V550 supplies recognized empirical position-coordinate names but not universal cross-source value equivalence.
Comparability must be field-specific and may require exact equality, versioned crosswalk, range/band, historical geography, source-specific semantics and/or temporal equivalence.

Some proposed mappings are not lawfully comparable, including generated structural position -> demographic coordinate, belief -> affiliation coordinate, memory -> objective biography and retroactive actor-response leakage.
A successful comparator emits only a D08-compatible EMPIRICAL POSSIBILITY-FIELD CONDITIONER, not a structural position, actor belief, response propensity, persona or finished possibility field.
